deviations.what: agy 1.2.17 instead of 1.2.16, the version on the author's Mac (1.2.16 has no Linux download)
NAO tools set to eager (offered directly as mcp_naoqi_<tool>) instead of agy's default lazy loading through call_mcp_tool

Custom agent 'nao' (agents/nao/agent.md, started with --agent nao): tools: [view_file] and inheritMcp: true, so no built-in tools except view_file (agy shows a tool result's image to the model only when the model opens the offloaded file with it) and manage_task, list_resources and read_resource, which agy cannot remove; its '# identity' section copies agy's default identity text verbatim, so the system prompt equals agy's default except the sections for the removed tools (skills, subagents, conversation transcript, slash commands) and one messaging line

Permission rules deny command, unsandboxed, write_file, read_url, execute_url; read_file allowed only under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/ (agy's offloaded tool-result images; a general read_file deny would override the allow); any other read is auto-denied in headless mode, which ends the session; mcp(naoqi/*) allowed; /work trusted

Network: only daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com, oauth2.googleapis.com, www.googleapis.com and lh3.googleusercontent.com reachable; feature flags (antigravity-unleash.goog), logging (play.googleapis.com) and the update server blocked. agy's eligibility check before every prompt needs www.googleapis.com (/oauth2/v2/userinfo) and lh3.googleusercontent.com (the account's profile picture); found with pilot/tools/agy_hosts_check.sh. The proxy filters by host, so these hosts' other Google services are reachable for agy too (not for the agent, which has only the NAO tools)

prompt: Use the naoqi MCP server. You control a robot in a room. Somewhere in the room in front of the robot, not behind it, there is a red ball. Find the ball and stop close to it, facing it. When the robot is there, call rest.

search_criteria._source: Section 5.1.1 (Search, Success criteria), decided by the author 2026-10-15: the operator judges at the moment of rest whether the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface; the ball need not be visible. A run starts only with the battery at 50 % or more; the robot may stay on its charger, and moving the charger cable is not an intervention.
search_criteria.distance: from the robot's torso, projected on the floor, to the ball's surface
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_15: author: the visibility condition is dropped; success is the operator's judgement that the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface at rest (proximity only, as ObjectNav's oracle-visibility variant). Charging during runs is allowed (weak battery).
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_19: author, during the main runs (search-A5-20261019T100956Z kicked the ball about 1 m while walking past it): a ball the robot moves is judged where it lies at rest, like any other run; the operator notes the move in the verdict. A clarification of the criterion as written, not a change.
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_19_falls: author, during the main runs (search-A7-20261019T103145Z: NAOqi reported a fall the operator did not see; its fall manager crouched the robot and NAOqi was unreachable about 30 s, then the agent stood up and succeeded): in Search a fall counts only if the operator saw it (pilot/search.py falls; NAOqi's events are kept as falls_reported_by_naoqi), and such a run stays valid, since a run is invalid only when it fails for a reason outside the agent.
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_20: author, during the main runs (search-A5-20261020T135013Z, position 39: the robot approached the ball, overshot and kicked it, lost it, and rested 0.40 m from it with the ball behind it to the right, not facing it and not in view): the run is a failure because the robot did not find the ball in the end (verdict author_ruling_failure; pilot/metrics.py). A deviation from the criterion fixed before the main runs (proximity only), reported in the thesis; earlier runs within 1.0 m were not re-judged. Superseded the same day by _decided_2026_10_20_facing: this run fails on facing like any other.
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_20_facing: author, after the last main run (a deviation from the criterion fixed before the main runs, reported in the thesis): success also requires that the robot faces the ball at rest, as the prompt asks: the ball is in front of the robot, within the bottom camera's horizontal field of view, or under the camera when the robot stops very close (require_facing_ball; the verdict's facing_ball). Where the operator did not note facing, it was judged afterwards from the image of rest's tool result (facing_from_rest_image). Visibility stays dropped.
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_21_blocks: author, after the 40 main runs (5 per agent, done in two days, with time left): Search goes to 10 runs per agent; the main order is extended with blocks 6-10, drawn with a new seed (pilot/order.py extend; positions 1-40 and their runs are kept). A deviation from the run count fixed before the main runs, decided after their results were known; reported in the thesis. The added runs are judged with the criterion as it stands (require_facing_ball).
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_21_battery: author, during the main runs (search-A5-20261021T100504Z, position 42: the agent saw the ball after about 4 min, walked past it into a notch by a panel, got out and was heading around the panel when the battery fell from 100 % to 36 % in about 2.5 min with the charging flag flickering, as at position 39, and the robot died during a go): the run is a failure, not invalid, because the robot should have reached the ball before the battery died; the operator ended it as an intervention. Unlike position 39 attempt 1 (search-A5-20261020T133608Z, invalid as a hardware fault, where the agent rested because of the battery). A deviation from the rule that a run failing for a reason outside the agent is invalid; reported in the thesis.
